cases.question: Can I return a product after opening it?
cases.answer: Opened or used products are eligible for return only if you experienced an adverse reaction or the product arrived damaged or defective. In these cases, please contact support with details before returning. You must provide proof of purchase, and returns must be made within 30 days of delivery.

cases.question: How long do refunds take?
cases.answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after approval, and it may take an additional 3-5 business days for the refund to appear on your statement depending on your bank or card issuer.

cases.question: How do I cancel my order?
cases.answer: To cancel your order, you must provide your order number to support so they can confirm if cancellation is possible. Orders can be cancelled free of charge within 2 hours of being placed if they have not yet entered processing. After processing has started, you must contact support to attempt to stop the shipment.

cases.question: What does niacinamide do?
cases.answer: Niacinamide is a form of vitamin B3 commonly used to help with the appearance of pores, uneven texture, and oil balance.
